title: Web output: publish a paper's full text to a Flowershow site
description: Second output of the same pipeline (2026-10-08). typst/build-paper.sh makes the PDF from 2rbook/<topic>/essay.md; add the web equivalent so one command publishes both. Shape: scripts/build-web (pandoc with the same sor.lua filter, writing Flowershow Markdown): read ../2rbook/wisdom/essay.md, convert summary boxes to callouts, keep footnotes, rewrite figure paths, add front matter (title, description, image) from the essay front matter, add links to landing page and PDF. Write to a target given as an argument, e.g. ../secondrenaissance.net/papers/wisdom/read.md + assets/wisdom/. Flowershow Cloud deploys on push to the site repo's main, so publishing = commit + push there; the script does it with --publish, otherwise leaves the diff for review. Entry point callable from 2rbook (e.g. 2rbook/scripts/publish wisdom -> pdf + web). Later: run it from a GitHub Action on pushes to 2rbook wisdom/** (opens a PR on the site repo). First user: rbook-8k3.35.
close_reason: Superseded by 2rbook rbook-8k3.36: web version is plain Markdown in the site's styling, a small copy script in 2rbook, no shared pipeline logic. Revisit if the web version gets richer (editorial marks, EPUB prp-37u).

title: SoR style: Typst style from the SoR design system; build the Wisdom paper
description: Implement the approved print mockups (design repo: design-34t.22, projects/sor-design-system/examples/print/) as typst/lib/styles/sor.typ, values from design/projects/sor-design-system/system/tokens.css; start from essay.typ for layout. Build 2rbook/wisdom/essay.md with current text and placeholder figures: cover, title page ('Seeds of Renaissance · No. 6', 'Wisdom · Part 1'), contents, summary boxes, chapter epigraphs per 2rbook/wisdom/publishing-annotations.md. Commit the PDF to output/ and copy it to design examples/print/ as the exemplar. Fonts: Polyamine and Restora need embedding licences (design-34t.2); use open stand-ins until then and say which. Blocked on design-34t.22 (mockups approved). Serves 2rbook rbook-8k3.4. Migrated from GitHub #6.
notes:
2026-10-07: font licences are not a concern (Rufus: have or will buy). Use Polyamine and Restora directly; no stand-ins needed.
2026-10-07: cover is not built here; it comes as a finished image from 2rbook rbook-8k3.29 and is placed as page 1. Page sequence: design print.md 'Anatomy of a paper' (design-34t.22).
close_reason: sor style (typst/lib/styles/sor.typ, spec docs/styles/sor.md) and typst/build-paper.sh; Wisdom builds to output/wisdom.pdf, 44pp, copied to design examples/print/ as exemplar. Restora and final cover follow-up in new bead.

title: Wisdom PDF: rebuild with Restora and the final cover
description: output/wisdom.pdf sets Restora slots (section heads, quotations, epigraphs, subtitle) in Fraunces because Restora isn't installed, and page 1 is the draft cover (2rbook wisdom/assets/wisdom-cover.webp). Once Restora is in fonts/licensed/ or installed, and rbook-8k3.29 exports wisdom-cover.png, rerun typst/build-paper.sh wisdom (it picks up both automatically), check the pages (Restora heads at 19/14pt among body copy have never been seen: type.md 'Before shipping'), commit, and copy to design examples/print/wisdom.pdf. Also fill the imprint's [Acknowledgements].
notes: 2026-10-08: Restora installed is the free sample only (ExtraLight 200, Thin Italic 100); build now uses it, so heads come out ExtraLight and quotations Thin Italic. Needs the licensed family (at least Regular, Medium, Italic) for heads at 19/14pt and quotations at 15pt. Cover: build now picks up wisdom-cover.jpg.

title: Delete the superseded v3 engine
description: typst/main.typ, typst/report.typ, typst/theme.typ (built by ./build.sh v3 into output/what-is-2r-typst.pdf) are superseded. Delete once the SoR style is approved. From GitHub #5.

title: Recover Google Docs conventions: bold-line section labels and paradigm triads
description: Two conventions render as plain bold paragraphs in output/what-is-2r.pdf: (1) bold-line labels, some sub-headings, some run-in heads; (2) Modern/Postmodern/Metamodern arrow triads that should set as small tables. Regex misfires (speaker labels, Claim standfirsts), so: scripts/labels.py --list proposes a classification, a human confirms once, answers go in a sidecar (source/what-is-2r.labels.txt) the build verifies. Triads: ^(Modern|Postmodern|Metamodern) →  runs of 2+ become a table; separate smaller change. Full detail: https://github.com/life-itself/pdf-report-publishing/issues/2

title: SoR papers: bibliography from a citation system
description: The Wisdom bibliography and further reading are hand-typed paragraphs in essay.md, set by scripts/sor.lua as hanging-indent entries (a paragraph with a year in its first 80 characters). Move references to BibTeX/Hayagriva and Typst's native bibliography (or pandoc citeproc) so entries are consistent, links format properly (some are bold in the source) and in-text citations can link to entries. Needs a decision with the authors on how they cite while drafting in Google Docs.

title: EPUB output from the same Markdown
description: Raised 2026-10-08 during the Wisdom launch. pandoc makes EPUB from the same Markdown and marks; needs cover image, metadata from front matter, a small CSS from the design system. Separate from the launch.

title: SoR style: US Letter build
description: print.md asks for papers as A4 and US Letter (215.9 x 279.4mm, same margins). typst/lib/styles/sor.typ is A4 only; positions on the title page, chapter openings and back cover are in mm from A4 edges. Add a paper-size input to build-paper.sh and check every fixed page at Letter.
close_reason: Won't do: papers are A4 only (design print.md, decided 2026-10-08 with Rufus)

title: Editorial craft as its own skill, for PDF and HTML
description: The craft of making a text read well (choosing standfirsts, pull quotes, summary boxes, epigraphs, emphasis, figure placement) is medium-independent but today sits inside the PDF skill (skills/pdf-report step 5) and docs/report-design-principles.md. Pull it out as a standalone 'editorial pass' skill whose output is the marks sidecar, consumed by the Typst build and by any HTML renderer. Split of concerns: design repo = look + anatomy of a paper (incl. how a pull quote looks, how often); this skill = how to choose and mark them from a given text; pipeline = turning marks into PDF/HTML.

title: Read essays from 2rbook instead of a local copy
description: source/ holds its own copy of the 2R essay. The pipeline should take its input from 2rbook (e.g. ../2rbook/what-is-2r/essay.md) so the text has one master. Noted 2026-10-07.
